capabilities: Insert date links from Chinese natural language input via an @ trigger
Offer this-week, next-week, and last-week candidates for ambiguous dates
Convert traditional lunar holidays to Gregorian dates offline for 1900-2100
Parse selected text into date links or plain dates via commands
Open the daily note for a Chinese date expression
extras: Does not include official vacation schedules or compensatory workdays; bare holiday names cover 1900-2100 only. Also installable by copying main.js and manifest.json from GitHub releases.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to type dates in Chinese natural language, and Chinese lunar holidays cannot be resolved to Gregorian dates.
summary: Chinese natural language date input that inserts date links and opens daily notes from expressions like @今天 or @下周三, in Simplified or Traditional Chinese.
